definitions.explanation: The detection and identification of a disease or condition at an early stage, before it has progressed significantly.

examples.japanese: {早期診断|そうきしんだん}が{大切|たいせつ}だ。
がんの{早期診断|そうきしんだん}で{命|いのち}が{助|たす}かった。
examples.english: Early diagnosis of cancer saved a life.

examples.japanese: {定期的|ていきてき}な{健康診断|けんこうしんだん}は{早期診断|そうきしんだん}・{早期治療|そうきちりょう}につながる。
examples.english: Regular health checkups lead to early diagnosis and early treatment.

notes:
A compound of {早期|そうき} (early stage) + {診断|しんだん} (diagnosis). Often paired with {早期治療|そうきちりょう} (early treatment) in the set phrase {早期診断|そうきしんだん}・{早期治療|そうきちりょう}, which is a cornerstone principle of Japanese preventive medicine.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {早期診断|そうきしんだん}・{早期治療|そうきちりょう}: early diagnosis and early treatment
- {早期診断|そうきしんだん}の{重要性|じゅうようせい}: importance of early diagnosis
- がんの{早期診断|そうきしんだん}: early diagnosis of cancer

RELATED WORDS:
- {早期発見|そうきはっけん}: early detection — finding a condition early, often used interchangeably
- {健康診断|けんこうしんだん}: health checkup — the examination that enables early diagnosis
- {人間ドック|にんげんどっく}: comprehensive medical checkup — a thorough examination popular in Japan
